insight: Founder Alan Cowen is an ex-Google scientist whose ‘semantic space theory’ of emotion underpins the product; $50M Series B (EQT, 2024).
name: Hume AI
tagline: Empathic Voice Interface — speech-to-speech AI that hears tone.
description: A voice AI toolkit built around the Empathic Voice Interface (EVI), a speech-to-speech model that infers emotion and prosody from a user's voice and modulates its replies accordingly. Exposed as an API for building expressive voice agents and assistants. From a research lab focused on emotional intelligence in AI.

modelSupport.notes: Pairs Hume's own voice/emotion models with a configurable LLM (e.g. Claude, GPT).

edge: EVI reads prosody and emotion in the user's voice — not just words — and tunes its own tone and timing in reply.
